originalText: {"job":"institution-ESA-issued-cfp","collectionState":"reconciled","verifiedOpen":false,"spaceRelevance":"not_assessed","recordType":"discovery_candidate","evidence":{"file":"institution-ESA-issued-cfp/page-1-653574d1f85a1eceda8b0ced7c243d96e5d2e354a18ea3425ce5891fd0f4cb7d.json","sha256":"653574d1f85a1eceda8b0ced7c243d96e5d2e354a18ea3425ce5891fd0f4cb7d","row":23,"retrievedAt":"2026-10-24T00:14:31.762Z"},"original":{"activityNumber":"1000046152","closingDate":"2029-12-31T13:00:00","clarificationRequestDeadline":"2029-12-17T13:00:00","description":"The InCubed Element of the European Earth Watch Programme (InCubed) aims to accompany European economic operators in the rapid evolution of the Earth Observation market, both in Europe and globally. InCubed introduces a dedicated process within ESA Earth Observation programmes to strengthen and stimulate the development of near-to-market commercial initiatives in partnership with industry. Activities supported under InCubed include the development and/or demonstration of space assets (e.g. missions, instruments, prototype elements of EO constellations), innovative mission management solutions (including for future EO constellations), as well as the development of ground, data, and application platforms. InCubed targets commercial viability by the end of the activity (at least at minimum viable product level) and requires a substantial degree of innovation, i.e. the creation of new value within the EO commercial landscape. Commercial customer engagement is mandatory, with customers acting as beta testers and validators of the developed product or service. Customer engagement must be clearly demonstrated at both pitch and proposal stages, and letters of support or interest from potential customers are considered a strong asset. normalized.title: NAVIGATION INNOVATION SUPPORT PROGRAMME ELEMENT 3 STANDARD CALL FOR PROPOSALS
normalized.description: Under NAVISP Element 3, the Agency issues this Call for Proposals for the development of initiatives in the Position, Navigation and Timing domain. Element 3 is focused on participating States' priorities and aims at supporting their national navigation activities along the whole value chain. Element 3 configures as an ad-hoc support element, which is envisaged per country and possibly per domain, for the development and promotion of products, applications and services based on GNSS and more widely on PNT systems. Following participating states request, ESA may provide technical assistance in various areas. Element 3 configures as an opportunity for the participating States delegations to animate and coordinate discussions with national entities and to set up the processes to identify and federate institutional demands. This will foster cooperation as well as possible national partnerships with a wide diversity of actors, enlarging the national space community (agency, industries, universities, and research centres) and strengthening its relationships with authorities, organisations, institutions, industries, and research actors from non-space sectors. Industry and research institutes of Participant States are encouraged to contact the NAVISP Element 3 team to discuss the development of activities of national relevance and matching institutional interests. Details on the tendering process and preparing the Full Proposal are provided in the Standard Call for Proposals.

originalText: {"job":"institution-ESA-issued-cfp","collectionState":"reconciled","verifiedOpen":false,"spaceRelevance":"not_assessed","recordType":"discovery_candidate","evidence":{"file":"institution-ESA-issued-cfp/page-2-a9dc23e07b40c74eaba85a069f72443c375e747cbf7e76c11d5a68f63f80fd2d.json","sha256":"a9dc23e07b40c74eaba85a069f72443c375e747cbf7e76c11d5a68f63f80fd2d","row":9,"retrievedAt":"2026-10-24T00:14:33.990Z"},"original":{"activityNumber":"1000025779","closingDate":"2027-12-31T13:00:00","clarificationRequestDeadline":"2027-12-17T13:00:00","description":"This procurement targets the delivery of the Copernicus Space Component acquisition services, including the Sentinels X-Band data acquisition operations and the S-band Telemetry, Tracking and Control (TTC) services.The X-Band Acquisition service aims at the on-ground reception of data sensed by the Sentinel satellites and the delivery of the acquired data in the form of CADU data stream for further ground segment operations. The TTC services aim at the reception of the satellite telecommands, their modulation and radiation to the satellite.Although covering different functions of the Copernicus Space Component (CSC) operations, the above-mentioned services may be considered rather similar in terms of required infrastructure and operations capabilities of the service providers.
